title: Loop 005 O001-R1 Temporal/Session Replication

dataset.name: NEMAR on002724 / OpenNeuro ds002724 training sessions
dataset.design: Each 40-second music trial contains two successive ~20-second target-affect segments. Event TSV provides target code at each segment onset.

role: Temporal/session generalization for participants overlapping the calibration cohort. Not an independent-population replication.
features: Exactly the O001 EEG band-power and ECG/GSR feature definitions unless a schema incompatibility is discovered before target inspection.

models.target_prior: target affect code + prior same-axis report -> Ridge
models.combined: target + prior + EEG PCA + ECG/GSR -> Ridge

evaluation.inner: GroupKFold on remaining subjects, 4 folds when feasible
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of held-out subjects

replication_success.for_each_axis: Primary O001 direction is considered session-replicated only if the corresponding combined-vs-prior baseline delta is >0 with 95% subject-bootstrap CI strictly above zero. Bidirectional modality complementarity additionally requires both modality-increment CIs >0.

interpretation_firewall: This is same-cohort temporal/session generalization, not external replication.
If O001 is negative, O001-R1 cannot retroactively redefine the primary endpoint.
